one_liner: Roboa develops robots for rescue operations and industrial inspections. Its 2025 recognition as an ETH Zurich spin-off is a reason to reach out now.

top_signals.signal: ETH Zurich recognizes Roboa as an academic spin-off.
Roboa received the Swiss Technology Award 2024 and support from programs including BRIDGE, Innosuisse and Venture Kick.

Model score 81.5 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). The score was lifted by the university spin-off, deep-tech and team flags: three known founders, technical founders including the CTO, and ETH Zurich backgrounds.

team: Alexander Kübler (CEO) and Pascal Auf der Maur (CTO) are technical co-founders. Betim Djambazi is the third co-founder. All three founder records list ETH Zurich.
why_early: Unknown whether a priced round has happened. Grants and awards are documented, but equity financing details are unavailable.
devils_advocate_risks: Robot reliability and safety across different operating environments remain open questions.
Ability to scale production to meet demand is unknown.
next_step: HTGF Industrial Tech team: Ask the founders what reliability data they have from industrial inspection field tests.
